label: Three omission scopes of giving, by derivation and finite controls (inference)
rule: Weaken the witness world; refute total refraining at the productive witness; compute the finite frames; reuse the STIT controls
meaning: A total-refraining world withholds every actual recipient; a roster-withholding world withholds each. A necessarily productive giver gives something at the refraining witness. A fixed giver gives the same at the withholding world. The Van Cleve, replacement and theist frames are evaluated case by case; pointwiseNotJoint and tiedNoEmptyChoice are the existing STITControls theorems.
